text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified them nor does it vouch for their accuracy.

- The regional meeting of the transportation working group of G-24 ended in Skopje. Several corridors defined in Southeast Europe. The most important for Macedonia is corridor 10 from Salzburg-Ljubljana-Zagreb-Belgrade-Nis to Thesaloniki.
- President of the constitutional court of Macedonia Jovan Proeski denied U.S. state department claims that some of the court editions were influenced by politics.
- Traffic between Macedonia and Bulgaria normalised after reopening of Deve Bair border crossing.
- Depositors of several bankrupt banks protested on Wednesday in front of the government building demaning compensation and punishment for banks' managers.
- Macedonian-French chamber for economic cooperation to be established in Skopje.
